::::::: hero-text
Sprout is a Python package for building up and describing research data. It
contributes to structuring your data into a [data
package](https://data-pkg-guide.seedcase-project.org) that follows data
engineering practices and [FAIR](https://www.go-fair.org/fair-principles/)
principles.

## Key features

- Processes prepared and tidied data into a final [data
  package](https://data-pkg-guide.seedcase-project.org)
- Stores data in [Apache Parquet](https://parquet.apache.org/) format---an open,
  efficient, and widely supported format.
- Extracts key metadata from your data, so you spend less time writing metadata
  manually.

## About the Seedcase Project

Sprout is part of the [**Seedcase Project**](https://seedcase-project.org),
which helps research projects manage and process data in line with the
[FAIR](https://www.go-fair.org/fair-principles/) principles.
